image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The center cap displays a Mitsubishi logo. The wheel is resting on green grass, and part of the car's dark grey fender is visible at the top.
